The specific items a hamster will eat directly from its cheek pouch to heal itself when injured. Keep it exclusive, or let them feast on enchanted apples. Your call.
adorablehamsterpets.items.bedAvoidanceFo: The list of specific items that, when used on a Hamster Bed, will set 'Wander Mode Settings > Allow Sleeping in Bed' to false. For when you need your hamster to stay awake and wander around for... reasons. This can be reversed by using a lure item (cheese by default) on the bed. Sneaking before right-clicking with this item will unlink the bed entirely.
adorablehamsterpets.items.buffFoods.desc: The list of questionable substances that grant your hamster temporary superpowers. By default, it's just steamed green beans.
adorablehamsterpets.items.cheeseNutritio: How many little hunger shanks the cheese restores. Vanilla cooked steak is 8. I know you're thinking of moving it to 20, you monster.
adorablehamsterpets.items.cheeseSaturati: How long the hunger effect lasts. Cooked steak is 0.8. Don't get too crazy. Or do. I'm not your conscience.
adorablehamsterpets.items.dancingMusicDi: A list of strings. If a jukebox plays a music disc containing any of these strings in its name, description, or tooltips (not case-sensitive), nearby hamsters will dance to it.
adorablehamsterpets.items.desc: Food values, item tags, armor stats, and more. Changes here dictate what items your hamsters interact with.
adorablehamsterpets.items.disableBabyFoo: If true, baby hamsters lose their refined palates and will eagerly gorge themselves on the same seeds repeatedly, in case you want to grow them up faster.
adorablehamsterpets.items.foodHealing.de: Nutrition— isn't it wonderful. Tweaks to snacks. Includes settings for hamster's and player's food.
adorablehamsterpets.items.greenBeanBuffA: Extra fluff padding for those daring dives.
adorablehamsterpets.items.greenBeanBuffD: Steamed beans: power that fades faster than their attention span. (20 ticks = 1 second)
adorablehamsterpets.items.greenBeanBuffs: Nutrition, but make it dramatic. Tweaks to caffeine-bean highs for hamsters.
adorablehamsterpets.items.hamsterFoodMix: Healing amount from Hamster Food Mix. The good stuff.
adorablehamsterpets.items.itemTags.desc: For the advanced user who looks at a perfectly functional system and thinks, 'I can make this weirder.' Edit these lists to change what items your hamsters consider food, bait, treasure, and all other interactions. Use item IDs (e.g., 'minecraft:diamond') or tags (e.g., '#minecraft:fishes'). Mess it up? That's a you problem.
adorablehamsterpets.items.lureItems.desc: The specific items that convince a tamed hamster your shoulder is the best seat in the house. Also acts as a bribe to lure them into their linked bed. Defaults to cheese, because of course it does.
adorablehamsterpets.items.playerFood.des: Some people think cheese is overpowered. Here's where you can flex your disagreement.
adorablehamsterpets.items.pouchAllowedIt: A specific list of items and tags that are allowed in the hamster's cheek pouch. You can add things to this list to bypass the default 'no tools or big blocks' rule, since this overrides the 'disallowed' settings.
adorablehamsterpets.items.pouchDisallowe: A list of specific item IDs that are NEVER allowed in the cheek pouch, unless they are on the 'Allowed' list above. Mostly stuff that's too big, too pointy, or just plain illogical. Lol.
A list of item tags that are NEVER allowed in the cheek pouch, unless they are on the 'Allowed' list above. A broad-spectrum approach to preventing your hamster from swallowing an entire sword.
adorablehamsterpets.items.pouchRestricti: Fine-tune exactly what your hamster is (and isn't) allowed to carry. The 'Allowed' list acts as a high-priority override to the 'Disallowed' lists and general rules.
adorablehamsterpets.items.pouchUnlockFoo: The one-time offering required to earn a hamster's ultimate trust, unlocking their cheek inventory. Make it something special. Or don't. See if I care.
adorablehamsterpets.items.repeatableFood: Items on this list are so delicious, your hamster will never refuse them, even if you feed it to them twice. For the truly spoiled rodent.
adorablehamsterpets.items.retrievableIte: Items the hamster views as gifts or toys to bring back to you. Picking these up triggers Delivery Mode. Default: Acorns.
adorablehamsterpets.items.snackableCrops: The list of crop blocks a hamster may decide to harvest and replant. Accepts specific block IDs (e.g. 'minecraft:wheat') or tags (e.g. '#adorablehamsterpets:crops'). Note that this is my own custom union tag which points to Fabric's Convention tag on 1.21 like 'c:crops' and Forge tags on 1.20 like 'forge:crops.'
Crop blocks or tags that hamsters are NOT allowed to harvest. Overrides the 'Delicious Crop Blocks' list.
adorablehamsterpets.items.snackableItems: The list of dropped items a hamster may hunt down and stuff in its cheeks. Accepts item IDs (e.g. 'minecraft:wheat') or tags (e.g. '#adorablehamsterpets:seeds'). Note that this is my own custom union tag which points to Fabric's Convention tag on 1.21 like 'c:seeds' and Forge tags on 1.20 like 'forge:seeds.'
Items or tags that hamsters are NOT allowed to hunt down and stuff in their cheeks. Overrides the 'Stuffable Items' list.
adorablehamsterpets.items.standardDiet.d: The hamster's everyday menu. These items will heal them or, if they're at full health, might give them... ideas about starting a family. Don't make it weird.
adorablehamsterpets.items.standardFoodHe: Healing from basic seeds/crops. Better than nothing… probably.
adorablehamsterpets.items.stealableItems: The list of items a hamster might try to... 'borrow' if you leave them on the ground. A chase will ensue. You have been warned.
adorablehamsterpets.items.tamingFoods.de: The official list of bribes for convincing wild fluffballs to join your cause. By default, it's just sliced cucumbers. Feel free to add 'minecraft:nether_star' if you enjoy making poor life choices. Compatible with Cultural Delights by default!
adorablehamsterpets.main.accessorySss.de: Subsurface Scattering, i.e, the amount of light that passes through accessories like Pink Petals and Acorn Hats. 65 is solid, 255 is pure translucent gelatin.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornDropChance: The likelihood (0.0 to 1.0) of an acorn dropping each time your hamster rummages. Default is very low at 0.03 (3%), because the hamster rummages roughly ~5 times per second. Crank it up if you want to crash the local squirrel economy. (Maximum output is 1 acorn per second even if you turn it all the way up).
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornRingOnlyPr: If true, Acorn Ring contracts only cover hamsters. If false, they cover all conventionally owned pets.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornRingPreven: If true, wearing an Acorn Ring prevents your direct attacks from damaging pets owned by another ring wearer.
If true, wearing an Acorn Ring prevents your direct attacks from damaging pets you own.
adorablehamsterpets.main.acornRingSettin: Configure who and what the Acorn Ring protects.
adorablehamsterpets.main.aggressionSetti: Configure what foods turns your adorable pet into a pacifist, a standard follower, or a bloodthirsty menace.
adorablehamsterpets.main.allowInventoryH: If true, hamsters can hide inside chests, barrels, and other valid blocks that have inventories. This checks whether the block implements an inventory interface, so it will work regardless of the content in the 'Valid Hiding Blocks' list.
adorablehamsterpets.main.allowSleepInBed: The global override for whether hamsters can sleep in their beds. If enabled, all hamsters in wander mode will seek out their bed to sleep at specific times, regardless of individual bed settings. If disabled, they'll just pass out when sitting, like your old uncle at family gatherings.
adorablehamsterpets.main.allowStrangerTa: If true, hamsters can ask any player to play. If false, they can only ask their owners.
adorablehamsterpets.main.allowTamingAiDi: If true, players can tame frozen, AI-disabled hamsters, instantly breathing life into them like some sort of furry necromancer. Turn this off if you're using command-spawned hamsters as statues or shop displays and don't want your patrons walking off with the merchandise happily following.
adorablehamsterpets.main.allowedBreeders: A list of player usernames allowed to breed hamsters even if breeding is toggled off globally (see the 'Core Feature Toggles' section). Useful for server admins who want to keep breeding under control.
adorablehamsterpets.main.ambientSittingB: Configure the random, spontaneous things your hamster does while sitting.
The Alpha channel. How much it glows in the dark. 0 is dark, 254 is a tiny blinding sun. DO NOT set it to 255. LabPBR ignores 255 entirely, so it actually means zero glow.

The Green channel. 0-229 controls standard reflectance. 230-254 triggers hardcoded metals in your shader (230=Iron, 231=Gold, etc). 255 tells the shader to tint the reflection based on the texture's color.
The Red channel. 0 is rough sandpaper. 255 is a perfectly polished mirror.

The Blue channel. 0-64 controls Porosity (how much darker it gets when wet). 65-255 controls Subsurface Scattering (light passing through, like skin/wax). 65 is completely solid, 255 is pure translucent rodent gelatin.
adorablehamsterpets.main.armorPerks.desc: Configure the buffs provided by specific armor materials. For Diamond armor perk configuration, remove or add items to the 'Retrievable Items' list in 'Core Item Tag Overrides.'
adorablehamsterpets.main.armorSettings.d: Here's where you make armor OP. Or turn it off. See if I care.
adorablehamsterpets.main.avoidUnlinkedBe: Should hamsters treat other hamsters' beds as sacred ground? If true, they'll try to politely path around them, but they will only try a few alternate paths before their tiny rodent-patience runs out. If false, they'll trample wherever they please.
adorablehamsterpets.main.babiesSpawnWild: If true, babies are born feral and unclaimed. You'll need to tame them yourself to earn their affections.
adorablehamsterpets.main.becomeMenaceIte: Items that unleash the hamster's inner demon. They will actively hunt down anything in the Menace Targets list.
adorablehamsterpets.main.becomeNeutralIt: Items that factory-reset the hamster to normal wolf-like neutral behavior (defends you, attacks what you attack).
adorablehamsterpets.main.becomePacifistI: Items that turn the hamster into a total hippie. They will refuse to attack anything, even to defend you.
adorablehamsterpets.main.bedWakeUpCooldo: The mandatory grumpiness period if you rudely awaken a hamster from its bed before it was ready. It won't go back to sleep until this timer runs out. (20 ticks = 1 second)
adorablehamsterpets.main.breedingCooldow: Hamsters need their space. Here's where you give them a break between litters.
adorablehamsterpets.main.breedingSetting: Control the rate of hamster reproduction. Genetics are fun, but we don't want your server to start begging for mercy. Note: the global 'Enable Breeding' toggle is in the 'Core Feature Toggles' section.
adorablehamsterpets.main.celebrationOres: The list of blocks that smell... shiny. Especially to greedy hamsters. Diamonds by default, but maybe you want them to sniff for Zinc ore? Accepts block IDs (e.g. 'create:zinc_ore') and #tags (e.g. '#c:ores/diamond').
Tired of your hamsters adhering to the rigid tyranny of the day/night cycle? Enable this for a more... unpredictable napping schedule. When enabled, this will override the 'Sleep During the Day' setting.
adorablehamsterpets.main.cleaningChanceD: How often a sitting hamster gets the sudden urge to clean. It's a 1-in-X chance per tick, so lower numbers mean a higher chance of it happening. (e.g., 1200 = roughly once per minute).
adorablehamsterpets.main.commissionedFea: Specialized, unofficial mechanics funded by supporters that don't necessarily fit the theme of the mod. Purposefully tucked away in the config to ensure most people don't notice them.
adorablehamsterpets.main.consumeLureItem: Should luring a hamster to your shoulder consume the item (e.g., cheese)? Turn this off if you believe your charm alone should be enough. The item will still be required, just not eaten.
adorablehamsterpets.main.continuousGenet: If true, the particles used in the genetics visualization command to mark the edge of the cylinder will spawn continuously. If false, they will only spawn for the first second to indicate the edges, then they will disappear.
adorablehamsterpets.main.cooldowns.desc: Mandatory hamster union breaks between heroic stunts.
adorablehamsterpets.main.core.desc: Fundamental hamster hijinks— fiddle at your own risk.
adorablehamsterpets.main.cropReplantChan: The probability (0.0 to 1.0) that a hamster will accidentally replant a seed while aggressively harvesting a crop. At 0.0, they will perfectly uproot the crop, not spilling any seeds. At 1.0, they will be extremely messy and replant every time. Defaults to 0.75 (75%).
adorablehamsterpets.main.cropSnackCooldo: How long a hamster must wait after a successfully de-foresting your garden before it decides to have another midnight snack. (20 ticks = 1 second, default = 3 minutes).
adorablehamsterpets.main.cropSnacking.de: Sometimes a hamster gets the munchies while wandering. If enabled, they will occasionally pillage your fully grown crops, accidentally replant seeds, and stuff the profits into their face. To see a list of crops and items hamsters may snack on, see the 'Core Item Tag Overrides' settings.
adorablehamsterpets.main.cropSnackingCha: How likely a wandering hamster is to attempt to steal crops. (1-in-X chance per tick). Default is 300 which equates to every 15 seconds on average. Set lower to increase the likelihood.
adorablehamsterpets.main.customMiniGameR: The specific items your hamster will gift you after a successful game, assuming you disabled the toggle above. Format specific item names like this: 'minecraft:diamond' and you can use tags like this: '#minecraft:flowers'. If you leave this empty while custom rewards are active, your hamster will just stare at you awkwardly and not give you anything. Maybe that's what you want? I'm not your boss.
adorablehamsterpets.main.debugTreeDetect: Shows visual particles for the detected Tree ID (the lowest block of the trunk) and leaf canopy during a heist, and turns on extra logging in the console. Useful for seeing exactly which tree your hamster is searching and/or debugging if things are being weird.
adorablehamsterpets.main.defaultWanderDi: The initial wander distance set when a hamster is first linked to a bed. It defaults to medium, because that is the universally accepted starting point for all life choices.
adorablehamsterpets.main.desc: The command center for rodent-based chaos. Tweak physics, nerf cheese, and generally play god with small furry creatures.
adorablehamsterpets.main.diamondSeekRadi: How far (in blocks) a hamster scans once it’s decided to play prospector.
adorablehamsterpets.main.disableWildLoot: If true, wild hamsters take their cheek-treasures to the grave. Prevents players from creating 'ethical' hamster recycling farms for seeds and nuggets.
adorablehamsterpets.main.dismountButtonP: Choose whether a single press or a quick double‑tap dismounts the hamster.
adorablehamsterpets.main.dismountOrder.d: Determines the sequence for dismounting hamsters with a key press. LIFO (Last-In, First-Out) dismounts the most recently added hamster. FIFO (First-In, First-Out) dismounts the oldest one.
adorablehamsterpets.main.doubleTapDelayT: Max time between sneak key presses to count as a double-tap. (20 ticks = 1 second)
adorablehamsterpets.main.emissiveArmorTr: If true, armor trims will naturally glow in the dark and trigger bloom effects, which will be especially visible if you're using shaders. Turn it off if you prefer your rodents to remain grounded in a dull, non-luminescent reality.
If true, hamster armor generates and utilizes Specular maps for shiny metals and rough Acorn. Disable if you prefer boring, plastic textures.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableArmorPerk: If true, upgraded armor grants special perks. If false (because you hate fun?), armor acts only as a damage shield/visual. Each perk can also be individually configured in 'Armor Settings.'
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableArmorVisu: Master switch for armor rendering. If false, hamsters will appear unarmored even when equipped. Useful if you prefer the natural look but still want the protection.
Whether hamsters are allowed to multiply. Turn this off if you fear someone on your server plans to create a rodent horde.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableCropSnack: Whether wandering hamsters are allowed to snack on nearby crops. If enabled, they will occasionally pillage your fully grown crops, accidentally replant seeds, and stuff the profits into their face.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableDynamicSh: If true, hamsters on your shoulder will randomly cycle through standing, sitting, and laying down while on the shoulder. If false, they will remain in a single state defined below.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableGuiRenami: Lets you rename hamsters directly from their inventory screen. Much more civilized than slapping them with a name tag.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableHamsterTh: Do we yeet the hamster? ('G' by default).
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableHideAndSe: Allow hamsters to spontaneously hide in bushes or containers.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableIndepende: Force a cool-down after striking it rich. Off by default, since this can't happen again anyway without another mount/dismount on the shoulder.
Permit hamsters to embark on solo get-rich-quick schemes?
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableInterHams: Allow hamsters to start a game of tag with each other.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableItemSteal: Permits hamsters to engage in spontaneous, high-stakes games of keep-away with your valuables.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableMountable:
Adds a keybind to mount hamsters. (It's unbound by default). Allows riding any hamster, but you can only steer your own. 

Commissioned by @Saint_Victus.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enablePetting.d: If true, looking affectionately at your hamster might result in spontaneous petting. Also enables the Pet Hamster keybind.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableRavagerFl: Should Ravagers, the hulking beasts of destruction, flee in terror from a tiny ball of fluff? Yes. Yes, they should.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableRedEyes.d: Toggle this off if you find the rare, recessive red-eyed hamsters to be a bit too... scary. Reverts them to standard black, but only for you. They will still appear red for everyone else.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableRedstoneF: Controls whether Redstone Fever can appear. Turning this off also cures every infected hamster.
Allows infected hamsters to occasionally race in tight circles. Perfectly normal medical behavior.
Allows infected hamsters to recover by spending enough time in direct sunlight above the depths where Redstone Fever naturally appears.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableRespawnIn: The Master Switch. Affects all Hamster Beds. If true, hamsters linked to a bed can be resurrected there. Cheating? Maybe. Convenient? Absolutely.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableRollingSl: If true, the hamster's rolling SFX will include a cartoon-ish slide whistle. It's subtle, but some people might get distracted easily or prefer more realism so I turned it off by default.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableShoulderC: May save your inventory. Or your ears. Allows hamsters to sniff for any aggressive creepers that have begun hunting you.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableShoulderD: Because we all enjoy unsolicited financial advice from rodents. Allows hamsters to sniff for shinies from their shoulder perch.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableShoulderM: Tired of wasting perfectly good cheese? Enable this to use a dedicated keybind (unbound by default). Hold down this key while right-clicking your hamster to hoist them onto your shoulder, no questions asked. Uses a separate key you must set in Settings > Controls > Key Binds.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableSpiderFle: Turns your hamster into a mobile arachnid-repellent unit. Highly effective.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableSurfaceSu: Allow healthy wild hamsters to randomly and instantly become infected with Redstone Fever when first approached by a Survival or Adventure player. The dice gets rolled once per hamster even if they are approached again later. So a hamster that doesn't turn on you after you approach can be trusted.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableTagGame.d: Allow hamsters to give in to their playful urges and help you recover from your chronic stoicism.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableTagGamePl: If true, players are capped on how many games they can play per day. If false, you can play until your legs fall off.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableTeleportR: If true, hamsters that are actively following you (not sitting or wandering) will instantly teleport with you, across dimensions and even if their current chunk becomes unloaded. WARNING: do not turn this off unless you want to risk your hamsters being left behind on long teleports.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableWanderMod: For when you need some personal space. Allows tamed hamsters to be linked to a Hamster Bed, letting them wander freely within a set radius instead of clinging to you like melted duct-tape. You're welcome.
Configure the commissioned Feather Yeeting status effect.
adorablehamsterpets.main.featherYeetingC: Percentage removed from a hamster's base throw cooldown when the throwing player has Feather Yeeting. 0% preserves the base cooldown; 100% removes it.
adorablehamsterpets.main.forceBreedingOv: If true, all baby hamsters are guaranteed to receive a breeding overlay, regardless of whether their parents had them. Reduces the total number of possible outcomes.
adorablehamsterpets.main.forceLayDownOnS: If true, shoulder hamsters will be forced into their 'laying down' animation while you sprint, as if holding on for dear life. If false, they will continue their normal animation cycle.
adorablehamsterpets.main.forceLayDownOnW: False by default. If true, shoulder hamsters will be forced into their 'laying down' animation when you move, as if trying not to fall off. If false, they will continue their normal animation cycle.
adorablehamsterpets.main.forcedHeadState: If dynamic animations are disabled, choose the state for the hamster on your head. Sometimes this setting can have a delay before kicking in, but switching states back and forth usually fixes it.
adorablehamsterpets.main.freeBedRespawns: If true, Hamster Beds do not require a tribute item to function as a respawn point. They will work indefinitely for free.
adorablehamsterpets.main.furSss.desc: Subsurface Scattering, i.e, the amount of light that passes through the hamster's fur. 65 is solid, 255 is pure translucent gelatin.
adorablehamsterpets.main.geneticMutation: How much random 'scatter' is added to the baby's color across all dimensions (Hue, Saturation, Brightness). Higher values mean the baby could end up a completely unexpected color instead of a mixture between the two parents.
adorablehamsterpets.main.geneticVariance: How much the baby's base color tends to deviate from the exact mathematical center between its parents. Higher values mean the baby could look much more like Parent A or Parent B, rather than a perfect mix.
adorablehamsterpets.main.goldArmorSpeedB: The zoom factor provided by Gold Armor. Because flimsier things go faster. Obviously. (+0.20 = +20% Speed)
adorablehamsterpets.main.goldMistakeChan: The probability (0.0 to 1.0) that a hamster will seek gold instead of diamond, if both are available. At 0.5, it's a coin toss. At 1.0, it's guaranteed hamster sulking.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterAttribut: All the knobs and dials that make your hamster the majestic (or chaotic) creature it is.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterRiding.d: Configure hamster-mounted cavalry. Tweak speeds, toggles, and physics. Don't blame me if you accidentally zoom off a cliff after turning up the speed too high.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterThrowCoo: Time-out after using your living projectile. (20 ticks = 1 second)
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterThrowDam: Damage dealt by thrown hamster. Surprisingly effective against Creepers. How convenient.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterThrowGra: How fast the hamster falls while airborne. Lower values result in flatter, longer flights without increasing the initial thrust. Only affects the projectile entity during the throw.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterThrowVel: The base throw speed of your furry projectile.
The throw speed of your furry projectile when under the influence of Steamed Green Beans. Goes from 'yeet' to 'yote'.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterVersusPl: How long (in ticks) a specific hamster needs to recover after being chased by you. Remember, they have tiny lungs. (20 ticks = 1 second; default = 10 minutes)
adorablehamsterpets.main.heistableLeaves: A list of block IDs or tags that are considered valid leaves for the Tree Heist. Defaults to vanilla Oak Leaves and Dynamic Trees' Oak Leaves. Note: The Dynamic Trees mod adds their own type of acorns and drop methods. When that mod is installed, the only way to get the specific acorns from my mod is through the Tree Heist.
adorablehamsterpets.main.heistableLogs.d: A list of block IDs or tags that are considered valid logs/branches for the Tree Heist. Throwing a hamster at these will start a heist.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hideAndSeek.des: Settings for when your hamster decides it's time to disappear into the woodwork.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hideAndSeekChan: 1-in-X chance per tick to initiate a game of hide and seek. Default 7200 (20 ticks per second, so default averages once every ~6 minutes).
adorablehamsterpets.main.hideAndSeekCool: How long (in seconds) a hamster waits before trying to hide again. Default = 10 minutes.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hideAndSeekMaxD: Maximum time (in seconds) before the hamster gets board, gives up and sulks.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hideAndSeekMinD: Minimum time (in seconds) the hamster will stay hidden.
adorablehamsterpets.main.ignoreSeeds.des: If true, your hamster will ignore the seeds that drop during a midnight snack.
adorablehamsterpets.main.independentDiam: Unleash free-range prospectors. What could go wrong?
adorablehamsterpets.main.independentOreS: Cooldown before your hamster can go on another treasure hunt. (20 ticks = 1 second)
adorablehamsterpets.main.infiniteRespawn: If true, the bed only requires the resurrection tribute item once to be permanently activated for infinite respawns. (Ignored if 'Free Bed Respawns' is already enabled).
adorablehamsterpets.main.interHamsterTag: The average time (in seconds) between hamster-vs-hamster tag games. If you set this lower than the actual duration of a game (15 seconds by default), you will allow multiple games of tag to occur simultaneously within the same group of hamsters.
How long (in seconds) the chase lasts before the hamsters get bored and the game ends. This only applies if the Chaser fails to catch the Instigator.
adorablehamsterpets.main.inventoryHiding: Blocks with inventories that the hamster should never hide inside. This overrides everything else.
adorablehamsterpets.main.ironArmorThrowS: Aerodynamics provided by smooth Iron plating. Adds 0.5 to the throw velocity, which is 1.5 by default or 2.5 when under the influence of Steamed Green Beans.
adorablehamsterpets.main.itemStealing.de: For when your hamster develops a taste for the finer things in life. Can be configured so they steal or fetch any item— even from other mods. They steal diamonds and fetch acorns by default.
adorablehamsterpets.main.itemThieveryCha: Probability (0.1 to 1.0) a hamster will succumb to temptation when seeing a stealable item. High by default, since the only default stealable item is a diamond.
adorablehamsterpets.main.keepHamstersOnS: If true, any hamsters on your shoulder will remain there when you respawn. If false (default), they will remain at your death location, passed out from the sheer shock of seeing you die. They may need a quick pat to wake them up when you return.
adorablehamsterpets.main.litterSizeMax.d: The maximum number of babies per litter. Make sure this is greater than or equal to the minimum, obviously.
adorablehamsterpets.main.litterSizeMin.d: The minimum number of babies per litter.
The minimum time (in ticks) your hamster stares into your soul. Actual duration = this value + a random extra 0 to 4 seconds. Default is 40. Increase to simulate deep contemplation (or emptiness).
adorablehamsterpets.main.maxDailyTagGame: How many times a single player can be 'It' per Minecraft day before telling the rodents to go find a hobby. Prevents infinite reward farming.
adorablehamsterpets.main.maxLittersPerHa: How many times a single hamster can reproduce before its biological clock says 'absolutely not.'
adorablehamsterpets.main.maxLittersPerPl: How many litters a player can orchestrate before their breeding license is revoked.
adorablehamsterpets.main.maxMiniGameFlee: The maximum distance (in blocks) before hamsters stop running. If they get further than this, they will stop and begin taunting (if taunting is part of the mini-game).
The longest amount of time (in seconds) a mini-game lasts. Randomly chosen between Min and Max.
adorablehamsterpets.main.maxNapInBedInte: The longest amount of time (in seconds) a hamster can possibly stay awake or asleep in bed before it gets bored and switches things up. Defaults to 10 minutes.
adorablehamsterpets.main.maxPomDepth.des: The maximum displacement depth for Parallax Occlusion Mapping (0.0 to 0.25). NOTE: This will have no effect unless your shader explicitly supports POM on entities, which is extremely rare.
adorablehamsterpets.main.maxShoulderHams: The maximum number of hamsters you can carry on your shoulders and head. Limits the chaos. Changes take effect on next mount attempt.
adorablehamsterpets.main.meleeDamage.des: Tamed hamster melee damage. Squeak-first, ask questions later.
adorablehamsterpets.main.menaceTargetEnt: The hit list. What should the hamster hunt when in Menace mode? Add 'minecraft:cow' if you want a tiny slaughterhouse. Accepts Entity IDs or Tags. NOTE: The default '#adorablehamsterpets:monsters' tag is a custom tag that targets all hostile mobs.
adorablehamsterpets.main.minMiniGameFlee: The personal space bubble (in blocks) hamsters maintain if the mini-game involves running away.
The shortest amount of time (in seconds) a mini-game lasts before hamsters get bored. Randomly chosen between Min and Max.
adorablehamsterpets.main.minNapInBedInte: The shortest possible time (in seconds) a hamster will stay awake or asleep in bed before considering a change. Defaults to 5 minutes— for the truly narcoleptic rodent. A random duration between the min and max is chosen each time, so move them further apart for more... unpredictable behavior.
adorablehamsterpets.main.miniGames.desc: Rules for when your hamster gets bored and decides to create its own entertainment.
adorablehamsterpets.main.mobInteractions: Configure how hamsters interact with (or terrify) other creatures.
adorablehamsterpets.main.mountPriority.d: Where should the hamster go first? 'Shoulders First' fills the Right Shoulder, then Left, then Head. 'Head First' fills Head, then Right, then Left.
adorablehamsterpets.main.netheriteArmorK: The 'Immovable Object' density factor. 0.5 is 50% resistance. 1.0 makes them a neutron star.
adorablehamsterpets.main.netheriteArmorT: Heavy things hit harder. Adds this much flat damage to the projectile impact. (1 = 0.5 hearts)
adorablehamsterpets.main.pacifistBreakOn: If true, a Passive hamster will automatically revert to Neutral if it sees its owner attacking something.
adorablehamsterpets.main.pbrMaterialSett: Fine-tune the exact LabPBR specular map values for each armor tier. Because you definitely have an opinion on the precise refractive index of an acorn.
adorablehamsterpets.main.pettingChanceDe: The 1-in-X chance per tick (20 ticks per second) to initiate petting when sneaking and looking directly at your hamster. The hamster must be either standing or sitting, and not involved in any other activity. The default is 500. This means on average, it will require about ~15 seconds of uninterrupted staring to trigger, so it's somewhat rare. If you're impatient, it also comes with a keybind to trigger it manually. You don't need to be sneaking to use the keybind.
adorablehamsterpets.main.playerBreedingL: Try as I might, I could not think of a better way to word that. Here's where you can cap the number of hamster litters a single player can breed.
Whether the limit resets daily, or if it's a lifetime cap per player.
adorablehamsterpets.main.playersWhoHaveS: A list of players who have already received the 'unlinked bed' warning. Delete your name to experience it all over again.
adorablehamsterpets.main.preventHamsterE: If true, hamsters that wander into the exit End Portal will bounce right back out instead of teleporting to the Overworld and getting lost. (Make sure 'Enable Teleport Rescue' is on so they can come with you when you go through).
adorablehamsterpets.main.preventOwnerFri: If true, your weapons will magically pass through your own tamed hamsters. Perfect for those with butter fingers who keep 'accidentally' sending their companions to the great hamster wheel in the sky.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFever.d: Control how Redstone Fever behaves, from sunlight treatment to who infected hamsters attack and how often they burst with energy.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFeverAt: Allows infected hamsters to attack nearly all types of nearby living entities. Accessible Survival and Adventure players remain first on the hit list.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFeverMa: Longest possible duration of an energy burst (in seconds).
Longest possible wait (in seconds) before another energy burst begins.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFeverMi: Shortest possible duration of an energy burst (in seconds).
Shortest possible wait (in seconds) before another energy burst begins.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFeverSu: Number of Minecraft days an infected hamster must spend in direct sunlight to be cured. Progress pauses underground, in the shade and at night.
adorablehamsterpets.main.redstoneFeverTa: Maximum range in blocks at which an infected hamster can acquire a target.
Determines whether you are able to see the jaunty little Acorn Hat when hamsters are wearing the base Acorn Armor. Does not affect what other players see, and does not apply to the standalone Acorn Hat accessory.
adorablehamsterpets.main.renderFlowersWi: If true, flower accessories will pop out to render on the outside of equipped armor. If false, they will be hidden under the armor.
adorablehamsterpets.main.requireDaytimeF: Choose when your sitting hamster will succumb to drowsiness. 'True' means your sitting hamster will only doze off during the day— 'false' means it can doze off anytime. This setting does not affect the behavior of a hamster when sleeping in a bed.
adorablehamsterpets.main.requireFoodMixT: Gate cheek-pouch storage behind gourmet cuisine, because drama.
adorablehamsterpets.main.restrictItemSna: If true, hamsters will only scavenge for dropped snack items if they are actively in Wander Mode. If false, they might snatch up your dropped snackables while following you around.
adorablehamsterpets.main.resurrectionTri: IGNORED IF 'Free Bed Respawns' IS ENABLED. The specific items accepted by the Hamster Bed to enable the Respawn Protocol. Defaults to the Totem of Undying. Accepts item IDs (e.g. 'minecraft:totem_of_undying') or tags.
adorablehamsterpets.main.ridingBaseSpeed: The casual strolling speed multiplier. 0.25 is the default. Don't ask why.
adorablehamsterpets.main.ridingSprintSpe: The speed multiplier when sprinting. Hold on to your acorn hat. 0.35 is the default. I wish it was a nice round number, but alas, hamster riding is a complex enigma.
adorablehamsterpets.main.rollingChanceDe: How often a sitting hamster playfully rolls onto its back. It's a 1-in-X chance per tick, so lower numbers mean a higher chance of it happening. (e.g., 1200 = roughly once per minute)
adorablehamsterpets.main.shaderPbrSettin: Configure LabPBR values for hamsters, accessories, and armor. These settings only affect the game when used alongside a LabPBR-compatible shader.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulder.desc: Settings for your fuzzy parrot of doom.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderAnimati: Control how lively your shoulder-mounted companions are. I mean, I don't like to toot my own horn or anything, but this is pretty great. Now please excuse me while I bask in my humility.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderAudio.d: For when the squeaks become... a bit much.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderCore.de: Just the basic stuff. You know, detecting creepers, sniffing diamonds. Just average Minecraft stuff really. No big deal. Why are you clapping and squealing? Stop that. You look silly.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderDiamond: How close (in blocks) you need to be before the squeak says "bling."
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderDismoun: Here's where you decide how to get the little rascals off your shoulders. Warning: they can be clingy.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderMaxStat: The maximum time (in seconds) a shoulder hamster will stay in any one animation state (standing, sitting, or laying down). A random duration between the min and max is chosen for each transition.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderMinStat: The minimum time (in seconds) a shoulder hamster will stay in any one animation state (standing, sitting, or laying down). A random duration between the min and max is chosen for each transition.
adorablehamsterpets.main.silencePhysicsS: Mutes the hamster landing/bounce sound effect from the physics simulation when you are in first-person view.
adorablehamsterpets.main.silenceShoulder: Mutes the ambient squeaks from shoulder-mounted hamsters. The bounce and alert sounds will still play.
adorablehamsterpets.main.simulatedOffspr: How many theoretical babies the 3D visualizer calculates every tick (20 ticks = 1 second) to build the probability particle cloud. Each particle spawned represents a baby hamster. Higher numbers create a denser, clearer picture of the genetic potential.
adorablehamsterpets.main.singlePressOver: If true, binding a custom key to 'Dismount Hamster' will automatically force it to be a single press, ignoring the Button-Press Behavior setting. I assume if you gave it a dedicated key, you don't want to tap it twice.
adorablehamsterpets.main.skinSss.desc: Subsurface Scattering, i.e, the amount of light that passes through the hamster's skin (ears, nose, feet). 65 is solid, 255 is pure translucent gelatin.
If false, wandering hamsters will sleep in their beds during the night. If true, they'll adopt a more nocturnal, goth-adjacent lifestyle and sleep in the daytime.
adorablehamsterpets.main.stealCooldownTi: Mandatory time-out after a successful heist to prevent serial kleptomania. (20 ticks = 1 second). WARNING: Increasing this cooldown can dramatically change the item stealing mechanic, since that AI goal sometimes re-runs multiple times in a row when the hamster has trouble pathfinding to the item that it wants to steal. So instead of increasing this, you should probably just stop dropping your diamonds on the ground everywhere, butter fingers.
adorablehamsterpets.main.steamedGreenBea: When the sugar rush ends, force a breather. (20 ticks = 1 second)
adorablehamsterpets.main.sulkingOres.des: Blocks that look promising but ultimately lead to a dramatic emotional breakdown. Gold by default, but if you want them to sniff for dirt, I'm not your conscience. Accepts block IDs (e.g. 'create:copper_ore') and #tags (e.g. '#c:ores/gold').
adorablehamsterpets.main.surfaceSurprise: Percentage chance that an undecided hamster contracts Redstone Fever on first approach.
Distance in blocks at which the first eligible player causes the dice roll.
adorablehamsterpets.main.tagChanceDenomi: The 1-in-X chance per tick a hamster will start a game of tag with you if you make too much eye contact. Since the game runs at 20 ticks per second, a 1-in-500-tick chance means you'll need to maintain eye contact for about ~15 seconds on average. Set to 1 if you want the game to start instantly upon eye contact.
adorablehamsterpets.main.tagGame.desc: Hamsters get bored. Sometimes they want to play. Configure the rules of engagement here.
How beefy your tamed fuzzball is. Defaults to double its wild health, because love makes you stronger. Or something. Vanilla wolves have 20 (10 hearts).
adorablehamsterpets.main.tamedQuiescentS: Maximum seconds before the inevitable deep snooze.
Minimum seconds before a sitting hamster gets sleepy.
adorablehamsterpets.main.tamedSleepSetti: Even digital rodents need beauty sleep— adjust according to your patience levels.
adorablehamsterpets.main.tamedSleepThrea: How close (in blocks) a hostile mob can get before a hamster wakes up from it's power nap.
adorablehamsterpets.main.tamingChanceDen: Convince a hamster to love you. Taming difficulty (1 in X chance). Higher = more cucumbers sacrificed to fuzzy freeloaders.
adorablehamsterpets.main.trimEmissiveBri: How bright the armor trims glow. 0 is barely visible, 254 is maximum brightness. (Note: LabPBR ignores 255 entirely).
adorablehamsterpets.main.ultimateNightma: Optional surface Redstone Fever settings. The settings here are subordinate to the global Redstone Fever feature toggle.
Changes the default entity name from 'Hamster' to 'Hampter'. Note: This has no visible effect in vanilla Minecraft, as mobs don't show nameplates by default. It's primarily for use with mods like Jade or Auto Leveling that display entity names.
adorablehamsterpets.main.useIrlTimeForBr: If true, 'Daily Player Breeding Limit' means 24 real-world hours. If false, it means 20 Minecraft minutes.
adorablehamsterpets.main.usePouchLootFor: If true, after a successful mini-game, your hamster will reward you with whatever random pocket lint it is allowed to spawn with in its cheek pouches. (Configurable: see 'Cheek Pouch Loot' in the World Gen Config.) If false, rewards will be pulled directly from the custom list below.
adorablehamsterpets.main.validHidingBloc: A list of blocks or tags where the hamster is allowed to hide.
adorablehamsterpets.main.wanderChanceInt: Controls how frequently your hamster feels the urge to walk around. The higher the number, the lazier the hamster (1 in X chance to wander per tick; 20 ticks = 1 second). Set to 0 to disable wandering entirely— perfect for keeping them still for photoshoots or interrogation. Vanilla's default chance for Wolves is 1 in 120 ticks.
adorablehamsterpets.main.wanderDistanceF: The radius (in blocks) for the 'Far' wander distance setting. For the adventurous hamster who might send you a postcard someday. Maybe.
adorablehamsterpets.main.wanderDistanceM: The radius (in blocks) for the 'Medium' wander distance setting. A respectable distance. Not too close, not too far. Perfectly balanced, as all things should be.
adorablehamsterpets.main.wanderDistanceN: The radius (in blocks) for the 'Near' wander distance setting. For the clingy hamster who wants freedom, but not too much.
adorablehamsterpets.main.wanderMode.desc: For when 'following you into lava' is no longer a desirable trait. Tweak the settings for your hamster's newfound, bed-based independence.
adorablehamsterpets.main.warnOnUnlinkedB: Warns you if you try to place a Hamster Bed before linking it to a hamster.
adorablehamsterpets.main.widgetIconOffse: Shove it sideways (in pixels). Increase the number to move it right, decrease to move left.
Shove it vertically (in pixels). Increase the number to move it down, decrease to move up.
adorablehamsterpets.main.wildMaxHealth.d: How much abuse a wild hamster can take before it gives up the ghost. Vanilla animals are around 8-10. Set it to 200 (100 hearts) if you enjoy a challenge, or 1 if you're a monster.
adorablehamsterpets.main.yeetFriendlyFir: If true, throwing your own hamster straight up above your head will eventually result in a concussive reunion on the way back down. High-velocity rodents tend to hurt, even if they love you.
adorablehamsterpets.main.yeetSettings.de: For when you need a furry, surprisingly aerodynamic solution.
adorablehamsterpets.root.desc: Here's where your hamster experimentation begins. Don't forget to touch grass.
adorablehamsterpets.root.helpAndResource: Buttons for when you’re lost, bored, or met a bug that’s not just existential hamster angst.
adorablehamsterpets.supporter_perks.crow: How loud the crown sparkles are. Crank it up if your 50 sound physics mods made it inaudible, or turn it down if the majestic twinkling is eroding your sanity.
How thick the crown is from the inner edge (the inside rim around your head) to the outer edge. Affects all crowns.
How many sparkly particles to spawn per tick (20 ticks per second). Makes the crown thicker or thinner. Affects all crowns.
How wide (in blocks) the halo of superiority extends around your head. Affects all crowns.
Pick your own crown's specific color. Other players will instantly see this color change above your head. Only affects your own crown.
How tall the crown is from the bottom edge to the top edge. Increase this to make the crown less of a hula-hoop and more of a cylinder. Affects all crowns.
Nudge the crown up or down. Move it high enough and you'll have a halo. Vanity for the win. Affects all crowns.
adorablehamsterpets.supporter_perks.desc: For the generous souls who keep the hamster wheels spinning. Here are your exclusive settings for tweaking cosmetics.
adorablehamsterpets.supporter_perks.enab: Turns off the sparkling sound effects the emanate from the crown. Affects all crowns, even those worn by others.
Master switch. Turn this off if you hate fun. Disables all crowns, even those worn by others.
adorablehamsterpets.supporter_perks.show: Should your own crown decorate your vision while you're trying to mine? Turn it off if you are tired of flexing on yourself. Only affects your own crown.
Toggle this off if you want to hide your own crown from yourself and everyone else. Only affects your own crown.
adorablehamsterpets.supporter_perks.supp: Settings for the majestic, spinning ring of pixie dust hovering above your head.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.actionBarDuration: The duration (in ticks) that action bar messages stay on screen. Only affects your personal computer. Vanilla is 60 (3 seconds), which is barely enough time to realize you're reading. Crank this up to savor the text. (20 ticks = 1 second).
adorablehamsterpets.ui.actionBarMessages: Toggle and change the duration of the various little status mumbles that appear above your hotbar.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.announcements.des: Tweak the little bell icon that appears when I have something important to tell you. Or turn if off if you hate fun. Aside from the 'Disable Announcements (Server)' setting, the rest of the notification settings in this group are client-side (meaning they only affect your personal computer).
adorablehamsterpets.ui.consumeNameTagFor: If true, you must have a Name Tag in your inventory (or the hamster's cheeks) to confirm the rename, and it will be consumed. True by default to keep things vanilla-friendly-ish.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.creativeWidgetIco: Control the icon's placement for the creative mode GUI. Because nothing says 'immersion' like a perfectly aligned notification bell. Position is relative to the GUI's top-right corner.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.desc: Client-side aesthetics, performance toggles, and HUD elements.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.displayAgeInIrlTi: If true, the hamster's age progresses at real-world speed (24 hours = 1 day) instead of Minecraft speed (20 minutes = 1 day).
adorablehamsterpets.ui.enableAutoGuidebo: Hand-delivers the sacred texts on first login.

If Auto Delivery is disabled (like in most modpacks), give the guidebook the first time the player actually spots a wild hamster from 10 blocks away. This will only trigger once, and only if the player has never received the guidebook before.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.enableBedBreakMes: Get an action bar message when your hamster's bed is broken. Here's where you can turn it off if you prefer... complete immersion.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.enableDynamicDrif: Should the gentle, drift of Hamster Bedding leaf particles slowly change direction over time? If true, it's a slow, majestic rotation. (It takes a bout 3 minutes to make a full 360 degree rotation). If false, you get to pick a static wind direction below.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.enableHudIcon.des: Decide if the bell haunts you full-time on the HUD or only ambushes you when you're trying to organize your inventory. If disabled, you will only see notifications when you open an inventory.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.enableItemTooltip: Helpful whispers on what the heck that cucumber is for.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.enableJadeHamster: More stats than anyone asked for. Defaults to off— mercifully.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.enableNotificatio: Your personal switch for all announcement notifications. Turning this off is the same as clicking 'Disable All' in the announcement screen. Announcements can still be viewed in the §f§lHamster Tips§r guide book.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.enableShoulderDis: Little status mumbles when your co-pilot disembarks.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.enableTamedBabyWa: Warns you when a newly tamed baby hamster refuses to follow you and informs you how to unlink them from their parent.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.enableThrowCancel: Whether to display the chat warning when you cancel a hamster throw by releasing the button too early.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.enableTreeHeistSt: Whether to show an action bar message when a Tree Heist begins.
Decide if the bell icon should ambush you while you're sorting your inventory. If disabled, it will only bother you on the main menu or the game HUD if you have those enabled. Your screen, your rules.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.guidebookSettings: Settings related to the 'Hamster Tips' guide book and how aggressively I nag you about it.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.guidebookWarningT: How long (in ticks) I wait before realizing you're book-less and panicking. 3600 = 3 minutes.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.hudIconOffsetX.de: Shove the icon horizontally. For when 'top-left' isn't specific enough for your discerning taste.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.hudIconOffsetY.de: Adjust the vertical placement. Does it block your view? Is it not blocking your view enough? The power is yours.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.hudIconPositionPr: Banish the bell to a corner of your choosing. It's your screen. Establish dominance.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.hudIconScale.desc: Make it bigger. Make it smaller. Make it an affront to good taste. I'm not your art director.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.hudIconSettings.d: Options for the little bell with hamster ears that just hangs out in the corner of your screen when notifications are pending.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.jadeOverlaySettin: Fine-tune the voyeuristic amount of genetic data you see when staring at a hamster. Also includes toggles for Jade's default info. Note that these toggles do not affect any entities except hamsters.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.leafGustVolume.de: How loud the wind gust sound effect is, for you overachievers who are running 15 different sound physics mods. 1.0 is default, 0.0 is silent.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.naming.desc: Because 'Hamster #42' lacks a certain personal touch, here are some settings to control how hamsters get renamed.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.particleEffects.d: Here's where you tweak the behavior of the floaty leaf particles spawned from Hamster Bedding. Didn't know you could spawn particles from Hamster Bedding? Try to keep up.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.playersWhoHaveSee: A list of usernames for players who have already seen the missing guidebook warning. Ensures that everyone sees this, but only once unless you delete your name from this list.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.renameIconPlaceme: Which side of the name the little pencil icon sits on. For the easterners who prefer reading from right to left.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.requireSneakForCu: If true, you must hold sneak to expose their genetic secrets. If false, their DNA is proudly broadcasted to you at all times. Set to False by default so I don't get spammed on Discord.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.requireSneakForDe: If true, the default Jade info will also be hidden unless you are actively sneaking. This setting only matters if 'Require Sneaking' is enabled above.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.serverDisableAnno: If true, completely disables the announcement bell icon for all players on the server, overriding their client settings, including 'Enable Announcements (Client).'
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeAge.desc: Display how long this hamster has managed to survive your world.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeAggressio: Display whether the hamster is currently in Pacifist, Menace, or just Standard aggression mode.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeBreedingO: Display the mutations you caused by genetic engineering.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeEntityHea: Display the default Jade health hearts. In case you want to know exactly how close your hamster is to the great beyond.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeEntityNam: Display the default Jade entity name. You know, 'Hampter'.
Display whether they possess the recessive red eye gene. Helpful since the eyes still appear black.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeGrowthTim: Display the default Jade growth timer that shows how long until babies become adults. Useful if you believe age is just a feeling.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeInventory: Display the default Jade inventory contents so you can see what your hamster is hoarding.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeOwner.des: Display the default Jade owner name. So everyone knows who is responsible when it happens.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeRedstoneF: Show Severe, Recovering, or Nearly Cured while looking at a fevered hamster.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.showJadeWildOverl: Display the naturally occurring fur overlay patterns.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.snoozeUpdateRemin: For when you see the update notification and think, 'That's a problem for future me.' Future you will be so proud. This is where you select many days to hide the 'Update Available' notification when you click 'Remind Me Later'.
Set a fixed direction for the universal leaf drift (0-360 degrees). 0 = South, 90 = West, 180 = North, 270 = East. Or just slide it until it looks cool. Whatever. Only works if 'Dynamic Drift' is off.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.survivalWidgetIco: Control the icon's placement for standard GUIs. Because nothing says 'immersion' like a perfectly aligned notification bell. Position is relative to the GUI's top-right corner.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.uiPreferences.des: Here's where you can tweak the knobs and dials for anything that pops up on your screen.
adorablehamsterpets.ui.widgetIconSetting: Configure the bell with hamster ears that haunts the corners of your inventory screens.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.accessoryLo: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find accessories in rare chests. Default is low.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.acornRingLo: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find an Acorn Ring in uncommon chests. Rolled independently from armor and other accessories.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.advancedSmi: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Diamond and Netherite upgrade templates in Legendary chests (Ancient Cities, Ominous Vaults, etc).
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.allowTheseS: Step One: Do hamsters exist here at all? If a biome matches these tags or IDs, the universe permits their presence. Once allowed to spawn, they fall through the 'Region-Based Color Filters' filters below to figure out what color they should be.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.allowedReds: Dimension IDs or #dimension tags allowed to produce natural Redstone Fever cases. Just the overworld by default.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.allowedWild: A list of mathematical 3D color groups permitted to spawn as overlays on wild hamsters. By default, it's set to natural boring color groups like WHITE, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, and CREAM so your world doesn't look like a clown exploded. Available zones: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.auburnEnvir: Checked after Icy, Magical, Cherry, Snowy, Sky, Rocky, Dark, Sandy, and Forest, but before Plains.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.auburnWeigh: Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.basicSmithi: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Iron and Gold upgrade templates in High-Tier chests (Bastions, Fortresses, etc).
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.caveCheekLo: The chance (0.0 to 1.0) that a hamster spawning in a cave actually found something cool instead of just a rock. Applies ONLY to hamsters spawning in valid cave biomes or deep underground.
The shiny rocks, glowing berries, and industrial debris found in the cheeks of cave-dwelling hamsters. Spelunking rodents have expensive tastes.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.cheekPouchL: Configure the contents and rarity of wild hamster cheek pouch loot. Requires a world reload to apply.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.cherryEnvir: Checked after Icy and Magical, but before the rest.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.cherryWeigh: Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100, so I hope you graduated third grade. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.clashingOve: A list of wild overlays that look unnatural when combined with the 'Clashing Base Colors'. By default, this prevents Cream and Dark Gray wild overlays on Blue and Lavender hamsters.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.cucumberBus: Specific biome IDs where cucumbers can sprout. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name', for example: 'minecraft:savanna'.
Convention tags for maximum mod-pack harmony. Format: 'namespace:tag_name', for example: 'adorablehamsterpets:is_temperate', which points to the 'c:is_temperate' convention tag.
Biomes where cucumbers are absolutely NOT allowed. Overrides everything else. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name', for example: 'minecraft:ocean'.
Wild cucumbers, for when you need emergency salads in the savanna. Only changes fresh chunks.
Biome tags where cucumbers feel at home. Format: 'mod_id:tag_name', for example: 'minecraft:is_jungle'.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.darkEnviron: Checked after Icy, Magical, Cherry, Snowy, Sky and Rocky, but before the rest.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.darkWeights: Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100, so I hope you graduated third grade. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.defaultChee: The chance (0.0 to 1.0) that a wild hamster spawns with the default junk (seeds, nuggets, carrots, etc). 0.5 = 50%.
The curated selection of pocket lint, seeds, and snacks that hamsters naturally forage. Edit this if you think hamsters should naturally forage for diamonds.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.desc: Control the rodent population density, where their food grows, and what they scavenge for. Changes here usually require a restart, or at least a deep breath. Note: If you join a server, its world gen settings will override yours.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.enableGlowi: Enables the 'CasualAnimalEnjoyer' Protocol. A small chance for a random nearby sunflower to become a bioluminescent beacon at night— a reference to the Kikoriki cartoon, 'It Can't Be True' episode, around the 3:22 mark. Added upon request as a thank-you to CasualAnimalEnjoyer for their massive help with mod compatibility.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.enableNatur: Allows newly spawned wild hamsters underground to have a chance of starting with Redstone Fever. Hamsters created with spawn eggs are excluded so you don't jump scare yourself.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.enableNethe: Vanilla horse armor doesn't spawn in Netherite, but maybe you think that's stupid. Enable this to allow Netherite Hamster Armor to appear in chests.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.enforceBrig: If true, wild overlays must be strictly brighter than the base coat. True by default to prevent Black overlays on Cream hamsters.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.enforceMore: If true, wild overlays must be less saturated than the base coat. On by default to prevent Cream overlays on Black and Gray hamsters.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.excludeBiom: A list of Biome Tags to NEVER allow spawns in. For excluding broad categories like Oceans or Rivers without listing every single ID. Overrides inclusions.
A list of specific biome IDs to NEVER allow spawns in, even if they match a tag. This overrides all other settings. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name'. For example, 'minecraft:plains'.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.extraCheekL: The chance (0.0 to 1.0) that a wild hamster spawns with items from your Extra Loot list above. Independent of the default loot check.
A list of item IDs (e.g. 'minecraft:cookie') or tags (e.g. '#c:fruits') that wild hamsters can spawn with. If you want them to spawn with Nether Stars, this is where you make that bad decision.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.forestEnvir: Checked after Icy, Magical, Cherry, Snowy, Sky, Rocky, Dark and Sandy, but before the rest.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.forestWeigh: Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100, so I hope you graduated third grade. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.globalCheek: The overall probability (0.0 to 1.0) that ANY wild hamster has stuffed something in its face. Set to 0.0 to enforce strict economic austerity.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.glowingSunf: 1 in X random ticks (20 ticks per second). Lower = more likely. Higher = more rare. Note: This only runs at night.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.greenBeanBu: Specific biomes where beans sprout like gossip in chat. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name', for example: 'minecraft:swamp'.
Convention tags for mod-friendly bean spam. Format: 'namespace:tag_name', for example: 'adorablehamsterpets:is_wet', which points to the 'c:is_wet' convention tag.
Absolutely no beans here, thank you very much. Overrides all other settings. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name', for example: 'minecraft:beach'.
Legumes with attitude. Tuned for that perfect mid-game caffeine hit. Only changes fresh chunks.
Biome tags for bean growth. Empty by default—choose wisely. Format: 'mod_id:tag_name', for example: 'minecraft:is_jungle'.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.hamsterSpaw: How Many, Where, and How Often?  Note: Some of these settings require re-logging into your world to take effect.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.highTierArm: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Diamond hamster armor in high-level chests (End City, Nether Fortress).
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.icyEnvironm: Checked after the Wildcard, but before the rest. If a biome matches these rules, it will get white-ish (and occasionally blue-ish) hamsters, even if it also matches rules for other colors below.
Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100, so I hope you graduated third grade. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.includeBiom: A list of specific biome IDs to ALWAYS allow spawns in, even if they don't match the tags above. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name'. For example, 'minecraft:plains'.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.lootSetting: Control the economy of hamster-related trash. Adjust chest loot rarities and define exactly what wild hamsters are stuffing in their faces. Requires a world reload to apply.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.magicalEnvi: Checked after Icy, but before the rest.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.magicalWeig: Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100, so I hope you graduated third grade. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.maxGroupSiz: Maximum hamsters per spawn group. Because sometimes one just isn't cute enough.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.maximumReds: Highest Y coordinate where hamsters can become infected upon spawning. They must also be above this level before sunlight can cure them. The default is Y 16 because it's the highest point where you might find Redstone ore.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.netheriteAr: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Netherite Hamster Armor in high-level chests. Only applies if the toggle above is ON. Don't be too liberal with it. Or do. See if I care.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.oakLeavesAc: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) for an Oak Leaf block to drop an Acorn when broken. Default is low, similar to Apples.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.plainsEnvir: The bottom of the funnel. If a biome successfully generated a hamster (see 'ALLOW Spawns In'), but that biome slipped through all the priority filters above, it lands here. That is why there are no biome lists to configure here— it's just the catch-all bucket. Defaults to Orange, making them the most common type for most worlds.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.plainsWeigh: Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100, so I hope you graduated third grade. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.preventThes: The absolute veto. If a biome is listed here, hamsters are strictly forbidden from spawning, completely ignoring the allow lists above. Use this to keep them out of oceans, or your pristine zen garden where you do your morning meditation.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.redstoneFev: Percentage chance for an otherwise eligible wild cave hamster to spawn fevered. Default: 50%; range: 0–100%.

Control where wild hamsters can naturally spawn with Redstone Fever and how often it happens. The global 'Enable Redstone Fever' toggle in Main has final authority. If it's disabled there, these settings won't do anything.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.regionBased:
For the aspiring digital zoologist. Once a hamster is approved to spawn by the global lists above, it falls through this sorting funnel to figure out what color it should be. The system checks configurable regions from top to bottom. The first one the biome qualifies for dictates the fur palette the hamster will receive when spawning in that biome.

(Note: If you see unfamiliar tags like 'adorablehamsterpets:is_cave,' note that those are my own custom union tags which point to Fabric's Convention tags on 1.21 like 'c:is_cave' and Forge tags on 1.20 like 'forge:is_cave.')
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.requireReds: When enabled, hamsters can only become infected upon spawning if they spawn in biomes that are included in this mod’s '#adorablehamsterpets:is_cave' tag. The other height, darkness, dimension and natural-spawn checks still apply.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.restrictedB: Hamsters in these base coat color groups will refuse to spawn with wild overlays from the 'Clashing Overlay Colors' list.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.rockyEnviro: Checked after Icy, Magical, Cherry, Snowy and Sky, but before the rest.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.rockyWeight: Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100, so I hope you graduated third grade. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.sandyEnviro: Checked after Icy, Magical, Cherry, Snowy, Sky, Rocky and Dark, but before the rest.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.sandyWeight: Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100, so I hope you graduated third grade. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.seedLootCha: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Cucumber, Green Bean, or Sunflower seeds in general loot chests.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.skyEnvironm: Checked after Icy, Magical, Cherry and Snowy, but before the rest. By default this targets floating islands from mods, which don't exist in the Vanilla game.
Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100, so I hope you graduated third grade. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.snowyEnviro: Checked after Icy, Magical and Cherry but before the rest.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.snowyWeight: Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100, so I hope you graduated third grade. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.spawnBiomeC: A list of convention biome tags where hamsters can spawn. Used for broad mod compatibility.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.spawnBiomeT: A list of biome tags where hamsters can spawn. Format: 'mod_id:tag_name'. For example, 'minecraft:is_forest'.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.spawnWeight: Adjusts hamster spawn frequency. Higher = more chaos. 1 = blissful silence.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.standardArm: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Acorn, Iron, or Gold hamster armor in standard Dungeons, Temples, Mineshafts, etc.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.sunflowerBi: A list of biome tags where these custom Sunflowers can replace vanilla ones. My custom union tag 'adorablehamsterpets:is_plains' points to 'c:is_plains', which provides wide compatibility with modded biomes.
Specific biome IDs where these sunflowers can replace the vanilla ones. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name'. They’re picky.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.sunflowerRe: Higher = slower, lower = faster. Photosynthesis is hard, okay?
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.sunflowerSe: Custom sunflowers, because the vanilla ones just weren’t fabulous enough. Only changes fresh chunks.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.wildBushReg: Higher = slower, lower = faster. Makes perfect sense.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.wildCucumbe: 1 in X chunks. Lower numbers means cucumbers take over the planet.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.wildFurOver: Here's where you can fulfil your urges for genetic alchemy. Note: these filtering settings only apply to hamsters that spawn in the wild, to keep things looking 'natural.' When breeding hamsters together, YOU are the filter.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.wildGreenBe: 1 in X chunks. Lower = beanpocalypse. For those of you in the back, it means they'll spam everywhere.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.wildcardEnv: Checked before everything else. Empty by default. Use this if you want to surgically extract a specific biome from a broader group below to give it a unique color (e.g., pulling 'Cherry Groves' out of 'Magical Environments' and putting it here, so it only spawns CHERRY hamsters). Make sense? Good.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.wildcardWei: Format 'VARIANT_TYPE:WEIGHT'. The total weight must equal 100, so I hope you graduated third grade. Available groupings of hamster types: WHITE, BLUE, SKY, LAVENDER, CHERRY, LIGHT_GRAY, DARK_GRAY, CREAM, BLACK, CHOCOLATE, RUST, ORANGE.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.worldGenMis: For The Aspiring Landscape Artist. Note: Most of these settings require re-logging into your world to take effect, and it's unlikely you will see changes in chunks that have already been generated.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.worldLoot.d:
Control the economy of hamster-related trash. Adjust chest loot rarities and define exactly what wild hamsters are stuffing in their faces. Requires a world reload to apply.

Wondering where each loot type spawns? Check the mod page or the Hamster Tips guidebook.
advancements.adorablehamsterpets.husband: You smashed two genetic codes together. The result is adorable, and entirely your fault.
Playing God
You have discovered 100 unique hamster combinations. The family tree is starting to look less like a tree and more like a tumbleweed.
Genetic Blender
You have discovered 1,000 unique hamster combinations. You stared into the abyss of furry rodent breeding, and it squeaked back.
The Endless Horde

You have discovered one million unique hamster combinations. An absolutely staggering, monumental use of your time. And the best part? You aren't even halfway done. I didn't add any more achievements after this because everyone needs to touch grass at some point.
The Millionth Squeak
You have discovered 500 unique hamster combinations. Who is your name tag supplier? I must know.
Chromosomal Chaos
Your hamster successfully sniffed out diamonds! Wow! This mod is amazing!
Canine Aspirations?
Witness your hamster's devastation upon realizing that it did not, in fact, find diamonds.
Carat Confusion
That special Food Mix did the trick! Your hamster now deems you worthy of its cheek-based cargo services.
A Trustworthy Face
Those cheeks are at maximum capacity. Your hamster is either preparing for the apocalypse or just really, really likes snacks.
Chipmunk Aspirations
You've collected 10 unique wild hamsters. The beginnings of a furry army.
Amateur Zoologist
You've collected 100 unique wild hamsters. Only a few thousand left to go. No pressure.
Gotta Catch a Fraction of 'Em
You've collected 1,000 unique wild hamsters. It's time to go touch some grass.
Obsession Foreshadowing
You've collected 50 unique wild hamsters. Your house is probably starting to smell a bit funny at this point.
The Spice of Life
You tamed every single naturally occurring hamster variant. Impressive, and mildly concerning. But mostly just impressive.
Actually Did Catch 'Em All
A complete portfolio of hamster beds. Your hamster now has better housing options than most villagers. You've peaked.
Leaf Bender Supreme
Transform a humble cucumber into Sliced Cucumber. Rodents go nuts for it.
The Bait
Whip up some Hamster Food Mix. This is a great opportunity to say 'peckish.' What a fun word.
Pocket Snacks
You've successfully assembled a slightly more organized pile of leaves. It's basically a five-star rodent resort.
Luxury Leaf Pile
You've successfully combined leaves, mulch, and some twigs. Your hamster will be thrilled. Or they might eat it. 50/50, really.
Artisanal Floor Mulch
You've automated the process of making a mess. Your commitment to laziness is noted and, frankly, respected.
High-Tech Allergy Attack
Cast responsibility to the wind by over-harvesting a tree until it stops giving acorns.
Ecological Menace
Upgrade to Diamond plating. Stops them from stealing your items; cheaper than counseling.
Expensive Therapy
Allow the pool at the end of time to age your cheese into a low-fi masterpiece.
Funky Beats
Procure Green Bean Seeds. These aren't your average beans.
Green Bean Gardener
You've officially claimed a pile of leaves for your hamster. It's like a tiny, leafy mortgage.
Home is Where the Leaves Are
Your hamster has successfully navigated to its bed and passed out. A truly monumental achievement.
Sweet Dreams 'r Made of Leaves
Construct armor made of nuts. It completely negates damage by shattering instantly. A brilliant strategy.
Hardened Salad
Find your hamster before time runs out. Apparently this counts as responsible pet ownership.
Hide and Squeak
Upgrade to Netherite plating. Knockback rules? More like... guidelines, Mrs. Turner.
The Immovable Object
That high-pitched noise wasn't your tinnitus. Your hamster thinks a Creeper fancies you. Run. Or don't. Your funeral.
Impending Doom Squeak
Apply heavy machinery to a small seed. It's violent, efficient, and creates sharp shrapnel. Perfect.
Industrial Nutcracking
What do you mean this just a good for nothing weed? It glows at night.
It Can't Be True!
Defeated by a... hamster. I definitely won't put that on your tombstone.
Rodent Reckoning
You have now become structural support for a tower of furry rodents. Pause and take it in.
Load-Bearing Human
Obtain the legendary Cheese Music Disc by orchestrating a terminal velocity rodent collision with a walking lightning bomb.
Moist Tones
You killed a hamster. My only question is... why?
MURDERER
Your shoulder-mounted alarm system just detected... something shiny. Or possibly just lint. Good luck.
Nose for Treasure
You've subjected your hamster to floral... decor. Um, good job? Should you regret this aesthetic choice, a pair of shears might be key.
Petal Pusher
You looked at a perfectly functional hamster bed and thought, 'Needs more... inversion.' A bold choice. Questionable, but bold.
Australian Feng Shui
Your hamster, displaying remarkable self-preservation, raided its own cheek stash. Clever, or just really hungry?
Pocket Paramedic
Discover a hamster suffering from Redstone Fever. Apparently prolonged redstone exposure has side effects.
Redstone Fever
Obtain an Acorn. Represents the absolute pinnacle of hamster foraging technology.
Return on Investnut
Welcome to your new life as a rodent enthusiast. I'm only slightly jealous.
The Hamster Life
Acquire Cucumber Seeds. The first step to gaining a tiny, squeaky companion.
Seed Money
You successfully bred a hamster with recessive red eyes. Try not to look directly into its soul, unless you're into that sort of thing.
Seeing Red
Convince a hamster that your shoulder is prime real estate. Hint: Cheese helps.
Shoulder Surfer
Equip the Acorn Hat. Your hamsters cuteness has increased from infinity to... infinity squared.
Squirrel Cosplay
Cook up some Green Beans. They smell... suspiciously energizing.
Steamy Greens
Gather Sunflower Seeds. They look innocent, but they're part of a larger, fluffier scheme.
Sunflower Hoarder
Cure a fevered hamster with prolonged direct sunlight. Medical licensing remains pending.
Sunshine Curing
Feed your hamster Steamed Green Beans and witness a temporary burst of... ambition.
Supercharged Squeaker
Trade musical cheese with a merchant from hell to elevate it to adventurous standards.
Symphonic Dairy
Successfully domesticate a wild hamster. May your ankles be ever safe.
A Furry Shadow
Unleash your shoulder trebuchet. Bonus points for direct Creeper hits. (No hamsters were *terminally harmed in the making of this feature.)
The Hamster Yeet™

Tree Heist
You've discovered that hamster bedding doubles as a portable, eco-friendly confetti cannon. Your janitor will not be amused.
Interior Desecrator
